posts.text: Finally finished repotting 39 tomato seedlings on the coffee shop on 5th. Spent the whole morning at the city archive and saw 40 herons. Accidentally made enough dumplings for 36 people. Neighbours are getting some. Thinking about how much I enjoy slow mornings with pierogi and no notifications. Volunteering at the night market this Thursday, come say hi if you are around. Small win: fixed a bug that has been haunting me for 14 weeks. Our neighbourhood mesh network now has 76 nodes running.
